segments.en: Peace and blessing to the honored self of my dear friend, my companion, precious and beloved to me greatly — who dwells within my heart [דיתיב בתונא דלבאי — Aramaic] — who drinks living waters from the purifying river, from all stains — Na Nach Nachma Nachman MayUman [מננמ"ח] — the distinguished Torah scholar, our Master [name missing], may he live.
